cohort: Women with Type 1 diabetes (n = 92), Type 2 diabetes (n = 106) and healthy women without diabetes (controls) (n = 119) from a tertiary obstetric centre
finding: Women with pre-existing diabetes had higher rates of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to healthy controls, while outcomes were similar between women with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, with the exception of higher birth weight gestational centile and rates of large for gestational age in the Type 1 diabetes group.
mod_finding: The study found no differences in pregnancy outcomes between women with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, although both groups had higher rates of emergency cesarean sections compared to healthy controls.
